) on Tuesday announced preliminary H1 fiscal 2027 revenue of $37.3 million and audio adjusted EBITDA of $7.8 million, up 619% from $1.1 million a year earlier.
Preliminary H1 fiscal 2027 consolidated adjusted EBITDA was $3.6 million, a $6.4 million improvement from a year earlier.
Preliminary Q2 fiscal 2027 audio adjusted EBITDA was $1.5 million, up 113% from $0.7 million a year earlier.
The preliminary Q2 Fiscal 2027 consolidated adjusted EBITDA loss was $0.7 million, a 30% improvement from a loss of $1 million a year earlier.
LiveOne said it has revised its fiscal 2027 and fiscal 2028 guidance to reflect updated launch timelines from its B2B partners.
LiveOne now expects revenue of $70 million to $75 million and adjusted EBITDA of $10 million or more for its fiscal 2027.
LiveOne also issued its first fiscal 2028 revenue guidance of $100 million or more as it anticipates launching the largest partnership in its history.

title: LiveOne sees H1 fiscal 2027 revenue of $37.3M
